turns.text: The sessions call fails with Invalid header and does not say which one. Which header is it?

attachment.name: sessions.txt
attachment.text:
curl -X POST https://dev.abdm.gov.in/api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions \
  -H "REQUEST-ID: 9c4d2e1f-7a3b-4f6e-8d2c-1b5a9e7f3c22" \
  -H "TIMESTAMP: 2026-09-29T10:20:31.402Z" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"clientId":"SBX_004512","clientSecret":"<MASKED_SECRET>","grantType":"client_credentials"}'

HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request

{"code":"ABDM-1032","message":"Invalid header"}

must_contain: X-CM-ID is missing from the pasted request; the session call requires it, and in the sandbox the value is sbx
ABDM-1032 means a required header is absent or unusable and the response does not say which; the gateway calls take REQUEST-ID, TIMESTAMP, X-CM-ID and Authorization
Check that each header is present, spelled exactly, with its hyphens and case
notes: Diagnose group, attached curl with a header absent: it catches an answer that blames the credentials or the body instead of reading the header set and naming the missing X-CM-ID.
